iterations.notes: three beats present and in order; ending delivered on the empty hands and the day ahead; M2 planted - the reader finishes certain Marcos knows something specific and has chosen silence, and reads the silence as care.

findings.quote: He understood: this was all Marcos would say, and the answer was his own to find.
findings.claim: The compressed beat 3 keeps both understandings but drops the reasoning that made Marcos s withholding read as love rather than evasion, which M2 requires.
findings.fix: Keep the compression and add a single phrase naming the care, without restoring the abstract moralising the prose critic charged.

iterations.notes: rescored after the patches. All three beats still present and in order; beat 3 still delivers both halves in its compressed single sentence; the ending is unchanged. The critic raised one high-severity finding against M2 which its scoring rule (3 per missing beat, 1 per beat out of order) does not charge, so the score stands at 10 and the finding is recorded open. ORCHESTRATOR ARBITRATION: UPHELD as a real observation and OVERRULED as grounds to redraft. It is in direct opposition to the prose critic, which scored the very same passage a major defect for explaining its own meaning. Both readings are defensible and the two critics now pull opposite ways on one paragraph, which is the deadlock the FLOW-3 audit exists to prevent and which arrived here anyway. The chapter reached the threshold and decide returned accept.
